items.q: In ’63, the assassination of President Kennedy, believe it or not, that was like a big downer that just made the whole world another place.

ctx.x: Did it seem like an era was over? Did these things -­

It seemed as though it was the end of an era. The glory days that extended from 1956 to 1962 were at an end. In ’63, the assassination of President Kennedy, believe it or not, that was like a big downer that just made the whole world another place. And growl, growl, in 1964 I had just had enough of my then-wife’s harassment. “Come off the road. Come off the road. Come off the road.
